camera._latency_note: Exposure -> frame-delivered delay. A frame's capture time = read time - latency_s. Fine-tune by eye with [ / ] in Unity's Mirror mode.

screen._note: Active display area of the 14in MacBook Pro (3024x1964 @ 254 ppi). Mirror-frame origin = lower-left corner.

camera_pose._note: Camera optical centre in Mirror frame (metres) and downward pitch. Laptop camera sits ~8 mm above the active area, centred.

depth._note: Weight of the Depth Anything metric estimate vs the BlazePose skeleton-scale estimate when fusing user distance.

compute._note: backend: auto (ONNX Runtime if installed, else OpenVINO) | onnx | openvino. *_device: auto | ane (Apple Neural Engine) | gpu (Apple GPU, NVIDIA TensorRT/CUDA, DirectML) | cpu. auto = ane on Macs, gpu with NVIDIA, else cpu. *_threads: CPU inference thread budgets (only used when a model runs on the CPU), 0 = auto (depth half the cores). Kept small: big pools burn battery for ~1 ms. Depth is capped because the distance it feeds is smoothed at < 1 Hz; depth_idle_hz applies when nobody is tracked.

filters._note: PosePredictor: One-Euro at rest, constant-velocity Kalman (accel_std, m/s^2) once the smoothed speed passes gate_speed (m/s). meas_std = landmark noise per Mirror axis (m).

predict._note: Sent to Unity, which extrapolates the pose to each rendered frame's display time: x + v*tau*(1-exp(-h/tau)), h <= max_horizon_s. blend_tc_s eases the hand-over when a new perception frame arrives.

gestures._note: swipe distances are in shoulder widths (sw) in the 2D image, so they don't depend on distance

net._mask_note: person-mask width sent to Unity for occlusion (0 = off)
